description: This file defines an 'embed' node for a rich text editor, including its attributes, rendering, and commands for inserting and updating embedded content such as iframes.

classes.name: EmbedNode
classes.description: Defines the 'embed' node with attributes, parsing, rendering, and command methods for embedding content.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the embed node, including HTML attributes.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Returns the group this node belongs to, here 'block'.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines attributes for the embed node such as src, width, height, and align.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies how to parse HTML to recognize embed nodes, here iframe tags with src attribute.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render the embed node as HTML, merging attributes into an iframe element.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a React-based view for the embed node, with update logic based on attribute changes.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides commands to insert an embed, set alignment, size, and source of the embed.
